links.outcome: Readability and understandability of chatbot answers about subperiosteal jaw implants
links.effect: Chatbots gave accurate, understandable information, but practical guidance and readability remained limited; CoPilot was less understandable and actionable than DeepSeek, Claude and ChatGPT. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: AI chatbots, such as DeepSeek, Claude, and ChatGPT, can provide accurate and understandable information about the subperiosteal jaw implants, though practical guidance and readability remain limited.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Copilot) on answering patient questions about subperiosteal jaw implants without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
